{{Quote|Why settled for outbidding a business rival, when you can ensure they never compete with you again?|Barabbula the Glib|<ref name="Encyclopedia" />}}
'''Barabbula''', better known as '''Barabbula the Glib''', was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who served as the [[Supreme Mogul]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. They were succeeded by [[Karagga]] around [[3840 BBY]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
